The Great Dames, led by 11th-year head coach [[Will Brown (basketball)|Will Brown]], played their home games at [[SEFCU Arena]] and are members of the [[America East Conference]]. They finished the season 19–15, 9–7 in America East play to finish in fourth place. They lost in the semifinals of the [[2012 America East men's basketball tournament|America East Basketball tournament]] to Stony Brook. They were invited to the [[2012 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|2012 CollegeInsider.com Tournament]], where they lost in the first round to Manhattan.{{cite news|url=https://www.nydailynews.com/2012/03/15/manhattan-jaspers-advance-to-cit-sweet-16-as-george-beamon-scores-34-points-in-89-79-win-over-albany/|title=Manhattan Jaspers advance to CIT Sweet 16, as George Beamon scores 34 points in 89-79 win over Albany|first=Sean|last=Brennan|work=[[New York Daily News]]|date=March 15, 2012|access-date=February 14, 2024}} ==Roster== {| class="wikitable" style="font-size: 95%;" !
